info.title: CarbonSynq University Intake
info.description: Human-reviewed spreadsheet normalization and PDF invoice batches within the existing /api/v2 service. Original files pass private-storage/scanning first. Import writes drafts, never approvals or emissions totals. PDF extraction requires a readable text layer; OCR is not configured. Domain constraints additionally apply; production acceptance is pending.
